study.title: MAENet: Multiple Attention Encoder-decoder Network for Farmland Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
study.short_title: MAENet: Multiple Attention Encoder-decoder Network for Farmland Segmentation
study.venue: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters

dataset.name: Three self-made farmland datasets, DJI Phantom 4 RTK UAV (Funan County, Anhui 2018; Dapo Township, Yunnan 2020)
dataset.note: 512x512 crops (12-pixel overlap), 4:1 train/test split. Dataset 1: 2420 images, 15 cm res, 2 classes (farmland/background). Dataset 2: 7264 images, 2.92 cm res, 2 classes. Dataset 3: 5 classes (background, tobacco 1-3, other farmland) derived from Dataset 2.

mIoU.quote: The MIoU and Kappa coefficient in the farmland multi-classification test set can reach 93.74% and 96.74%.
mIoU.ambiguity: MIoU 93.74% on Dataset 3 (5-class farmland multi-classification test set).

PA.ambiguity: Kappa 0.967 also reported but not a schema pixel-accuracy metric.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Farmland/crop-plot segmentation; paper notes weed identification qualitatively only.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-crop IoU reported (e.g., 84.89% for unbalanced tobacco class), not F1.

fps.ambiguity: Trained on NVIDIA 2080Ti; no inference/edge metrics.

issues: Farmland plot segmentation (5 tobacco classes), not crop-weed discrimination per se
